description: The identity of one packed owner release: the package it carries, the version the package half bumped to, the sha512 digest of the tarball, the branch-relative path of that tarball, and the package commit it was packed from. It is what crosses between an owner route and a consumer route: a library.update branch under mode publish writes it beside its archive, and a library.update branch under mode consume reads it as its input. Publishing to a registry is a person's authority and no operator of this tree holds it, so publication.state is pending until a person records otherwise outside the run.
